acceptance: `evolve carryover list --json` on a fixture state.json prints every todo with its age and cycles_unpicked (red: unknown subcommand "list")
Ids it prints are accepted verbatim by `carryover apply-decisions`
fix: Add `evolve carryover list [--json] [--sort age|unpicked] [--limit N]`. It prints one row per todo (id, source cycle, age, expiresAt, cycles_unpicked, priority), read through the statemap adapter that apply-decisions writes through. It is read-only and takes no flock. The ids it prints are the ones a keep/drop/cluster decisions file names. Exit 0, or exit 2 when state.json is unreadable. Document it in runtime-reference.md's operator commands.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: state.json:carryoverTodos is the auto-generated backlog that triage reads (764 entries when last measured; inbox carryover-queue-unbounded-by-design). `evolve carryover` has one subcommand, apply-decisions (cmd_carryover.go:45), which needs a reviewed decisions file, and the dashboard snapshot leaves carryover out. To write that file, the operator first reads the queue with jq on .evolve/state.json.
title: carryoverTodos can be reviewed only with jq on state.json; add `evolve carryover list`
